findings.what: The body of a test is cut at the first line '^);'. When a title of E2K-18 or E2K-38 gets short enough that prettier writes test("...", LIMIT, async () => { on one line, the closing line is '});' and the body runs into the following tests: a harmless edit gives a long false report (checked in the copy). Same at print width 120.
findings.fix: Cut the body at the next line that starts a test( (or at '^}?\);' of the same call), not at '^);'.

findings.what: Only whole-line // comments are blanked. The required assertion hidden in a trailing comment, a /* */ comment, a string or template literal, an if (false) or a never-called arrow keeps E2K-63 green (P1-P5); the test then no longer waits at all. Accidental regressions are caught, so this is only a hardening.
findings.fix: Blank trailing // and /* */ comments and string/template contents (keep offsets), and ask for the assertion at the statement level of the loop/scenario body; or accept and record as a known limit of a source guard.
